onlineOrder.heroSubtitle: Ordering luxury furniture has never been simpler. Transparent process, secure European payment, and insured home delivery across Europe.
onlineOrder.step1Desc: Browse our luxury furniture collections. Filter by category, designer brand, or finish. Add desired pieces to your selection.
onlineOrder.step2Desc: Provide your contact details and European delivery address. Our design team reviews your order and sends a custom proposal within 24 hours.
onlineOrder.step3Desc: Receive a detailed invoice via email. Confirm and complete payment 100% securely via bank wire, Visa, Mastercard, or PayPal.
onlineOrder.step4Desc: We coordinate delivery directly to your home. For large pieces, room placement and assembly service are available upon request.
onlineOrder.returnsDesc: If you are not entirely satisfied, you have 30 days to return your piece. We arrange pickup with no extra hassle.
onlineOrder.securePaymentDesc: All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption. We support SEPA bank transfer, Visa, Mastercard, and PayPal.
onlineOrder.supportDesc: Our interior consultants are available via WhatsApp, email, and phone to assist you at every step of your project.
onlineOrder.faq1A: Standard delivery timeframe is 5 to 15 business days depending on the piece and your location in Europe. Made-to-order custom items may take 4 to 8 weeks.
onlineOrder.faq2Q: Do you ship to all of Europe?
onlineOrder.faq2A: Yes, we ship to all European countries with full cargo insurance and direct real-time tracking.
onlineOrder.faq3A: Most items arrive pre-assembled or require minimal assembly (attaching legs, setting cushions). Detailed illustrated guides are included with every piece.
onlineOrder.faq4A: You have 30 calendar days from receipt to request a return in original condition. Contact info@mura-homes.com to arrange seamless pickup.
onlineOrder.faq5Q: Can I see products in person before ordering?
onlineOrder.faq5A: Yes. You can visit our showroom in Usurbil, Gipuzkoa, or request a private virtual consultation with our design consultants.
onlineOrder.noAnswerPrompt: Have a question not answered here?

about.heroDescription: Founded on the conviction that the furniture we live with should elevate our daily experience. What began as a boutique curation of local artisan creations has blossomed into a definitive collection of international luxury design.
about.foundersStoryP1: Our founders spent their formative years surrounded by the architectural richness of the Mediterranean. They learned early on that true luxury is not about ostentation, but about the purity of raw materials, proportional precision, and uncompromising craftsmanship.
about.foundersStoryP2: Today, MuraHomes collaborates with the world's most exacting manufacturers — from multigenerational Italian leather ateliers to cutting-edge Scandinavian studios — offering an unmatched selection to our discerning clients.
about.logisticsDesc: Our fulfillment center in Usurbil manages hundreds of bespoke design pieces in transit. Each delivery is packed with the same meticulous care with which it was crafted — protected down to the final mile.
about.value1Desc: We select pieces not merely for aesthetic allure, but for structural integrity and timeless durability. Authentic design must endure for generations.
about.value2Desc: We champion ateliers that honor their environment, prioritizing responsible timber sourcing, ethical craftsmanship, and low-impact production.
about.value3Desc: Our relationship with clients extends far beyond a transaction. We act as aesthetic advisors, orchestrating cohesive luxury interiors.
about.value4Desc: Every brand in our network is anchored in generational artisanal wisdom — workshops that have spent over a century perfecting their trade.

reviews.heroDescription: Over 3,000 families trust MuraHomes to decorate their homes. Here are some of their stories.

r1.title: Exceeded all my expectations
r1.body: I had been looking for a sofa that combined real comfort with a timeless design for months. The Veneto is exactly that. The bouclé upholstery is as soft as it looks in the photos. The MuraHomes team helped me choose the ideal color for my living room. Punctual delivery and assembly included. I could not be happier.

r2.title: Museum quality, reasonable price for what it is
r2.body: I bought the Giardino table for the dining room of our house in Sitges. The teak wood is spectacular, each grain is unique. I had a doubt about the dimensions and they answered me on WhatsApp in less than an hour. The table arrived perfectly packed in plywood. We are already thinking about the chairs.

r3.title: The armchair that has been my favorite for years
r3.body: I have bought furniture in many places but MuraHomes has something different: they treat you like a valuable customer, not like a number. The armchair is simply perfect. The Italian leather improves over time. I put it next to the fireplace and it is the favorite corner of the house. 100% recommended.

r4.title: Very fast shipping, impeccable product
r4.body: I ordered the lamp for a housewarming gift. They confirmed the order immediately and it arrived in 3 business days with incredible packaging. The matte brass design is exactly the same as in the photos, no nasty surprises. My friend could not believe it when I told her I bought it online.

r5.title: First class customer service
r5.body: I had a small flaw in a drawer when it arrived. I sent a message and in 24 hours they had already sent the replacement without asking anything else. That says a lot about a company. The dresser itself is beautiful, the oak wood and brass finishes are of a very high quality. I will definitely buy again.

r6.title: Very happy, slight delay in delivery
r6.body: The terrace set is spectacular, premium quality teak and the cushions perfectly withstand the sun of Seville. There was a 5-day delay in delivery due to stock issues, but they informed me in advance and offered me a discount on the next order. Overall very good experience.
